title: Ecological Metadata Harvester
subtitle: Enterprise-grade system for ecological metadata ingestion, validation and DSpace repository integration
description: An enterprise-grade system designed to ingest, validate and manage ecological metadata such as Movebank XML and Darwin Core Archives with integration into institutional DSpace repositories.
longDescription: The system is split into an enterprise backend (Java 21, Spring Boot, WebFlux, PostgreSQL, Flyway) and a modern frontend administrative dashboard (Angular 22, Signals, Standalone Components). It provides multi-format scientific file uploads, real-time metrics tracking, automated metadata validation and DSpace repository synchronization.

architecture.title: Full-Stack Repository Ingestion Pipeline
architecture.description: Decoupled enterprise architecture bridging Spring Boot microservices with an Angular 22 administrative dashboard.
steps: Backend REST API built with Spring Boot, WebFlux and Spring Data JPA handling metadata validation and database management via Flyway
Secure local persistence layer utilizing PostgreSQL (hosted via Neon / Docker) with isolated sandbox execution support
Angular 22 Single Page Application administrative dashboard providing multi-format upload wizards and repository explorers
Seamless integration bridge targeting institutional DSpace repositories and standard formats like Movebank XML and Darwin Core Archives (DwC-A)

scientificImpact: Automates the ingestion and validation of complex multi-format ecological metadata standards
Streamlines synchronization between local research data pipelines and institutional DSpace repositories
Provides researchers and administrators with robust audit trails, provenance logs and anomaly detection
keyFeatures: Multi-format scientific ingestion supporting Movebank XML, Darwin Core Archives and JSON Schemas
Real-time administrative dashboard tracking dataset metrics, successful harvests and validation failures
Repository explorer for inspecting harvested metadata records and diagnosing structural status
Enterprise-ready Java 21 / Spring Boot backend featuring interactive OpenAPI/Swagger documentation
Asynchronous processing pipeline handling high-volume metadata ingestion without blocking threads
Secure local database persistence via PostgreSQL with Flyway database migration management
